title: Vandimir Probable NDE 3386
content: I jumped out of my dad's apple tree so as not to get yelled at. The jump landed me on a pile of old boards my dad salvaged from construction sites. I landed on a board that had a large nail, which pierced my right foot, sticking out at the front of the ankle. No doctor was available in rural Iowa, so my mom patched me up as best she could. Days later the doctor did show up and decided to give me a tetanus shot 'just to be safe'. I had an acute allergic reaction to the shot. All my muscles constricted and soon I was all twisted in a knot. Then followed painful muscle cramps and finally unconsciousness. At some point, I stopped breathing and my heart stopped beating. The doctor who gave me the shot was right there, and he did whatever it took to bring me back. My first memory is of falling through blackness. It didn't seem to bother me, but got a little boring. Then I noticed a small light way off in the distance. With nothing better to do, I sort of fell in that direction. When I got close enough I could see that it was a person. He was head to toe consumed in flame, as well as falling through blackness. I said, 'Hi, my name's Joe.' He said 'I am forever falling and forever burning.' He told me that some long time ago, he and I were one, and if he had anything to say about it, we would be one again someday. He told me my name would be Vandimir, and I would be a Magician. 'Will I be famous?' I asked. 'You shall be well known, if not well loved.' To a five year old, all this sounded pretty far out, but what could I do? So I said 'Okay'. He said he didn't have to be always falling and burning through blackness. He instructed me to take the tip of my right index finger and touch a spot in space directly in front of my face. 'Touch it, and make a blue dot appear.' When the dot appeared, he said I should expand the dot until the blue covers all. 'Come into the blue,' he said, 'for I am of the blue.' In that world, he was a young man in a white robe who lived in a beautiful park. He told me how to call him up so we could be together anytime. From then on, the dreams have never stopped. I went back to visit him many times and it was always wondrous. I had difficulty in school, as I could not at that age tell the difference between the dream world and the waking world. I was caught a few times talking to the invisible man. Several trips to different shrinks didn't help. The only help came from 'the other side'. I didn't make many friends, got kicked out of several schools, went to college because my mom said I'd never amount to anything if I didn't. I studied dreams, and psychology, parapsychology, scrying, medium ship, possession. Eventually all this led me to join a magical fraternity. There I learned trance working, and finally got a handle on the dreams. Now I can control them a little, but I've never found the 'off' switch.

arrival.other_being_detail: A person 'head to toe consumed in flame' who said, 'I am forever falling and forever burning,' and later identified himself as 'of the blue' and appeared as a young man in a white robe.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'beautiful park' and an all-encompassing 'blue' created/expanded from a dot.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: The being told him his name would be Vandimir and he would be 'a Magician,' and taught him a method ('make a blue dot appear... expand the dot...') and how to 'call him up so we could be together anytime.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Acute allergic reaction to a tetanus shot after a nail puncture wound; stopped breathing and heart stopped beating; doctor resuscitated him.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Instruction to create/expand a 'blue dot' and enter 'the blue'; ongoing subsequent visitations described as dreams.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Falling through blackness (void) preceded the encounter with a distant light/being; no OBE, life review, or boundary described.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: The being was also described as 'falling through blackness' while encountered.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A flaming falling figure who teaches a visualization technique ('make a blue dot appear... expand the dot until the blue covers all') leading to entry into 'the blue' where he appears as a robed young man in a park; persistent lifelong dream-visitations and difficulty distinguishing dream vs waking reality.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'I am forever falling and forever burning.' / 'Touch it, and make a blue dot appear.' / 'Come into the blue,' he said, 'for I am of the blue.' / 'You shall be well known, if not well loved.'
